lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Welcome to the board! Today's question: what is an API?
lines.tts: Welcome to the board! Today's question: what is an A P I?

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Hi Juno! I keep hearing about APIs. What is one?
lines.tts: Hi Juno! I keep hearing about A P Is. What is one?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Picture a restaurant. You sit at a table; the food is made in the kitchen.
lines.tts: Picture a restaurant. You sit at a table; the food is made in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: But I cannot just walk into the kitchen, right?
lines.tts: But I cannot just walk into the kitchen, right?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Exactly! The waiter carries your order to the kitchen, then brings the food back.
lines.tts: Exactly! The waiter carries your order to the kitchen, then brings the food back.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Oh! So the waiter is the API?
lines.tts: Oh! So the waiter is the A P I?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Yes! An API is a waiter between your app and a server, carrying requests and responses.
lines.tts: Yes! An A P I is a waiter between your app and a server, carrying requests and responses.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Neat! But how do I know what to order?
lines.tts: Neat! But how do I know what to order?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: The menu lists what you can order. For an API, that is the documentation.
lines.tts: The menu lists what you can order. For an A P I, that is the documentation.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Got it! Request in, response out. Thanks, Juno!
lines.tts: Got it! Request in, response out. Thanks, Juno!
